_comment: Shared (recommended)-marker grammar vectors. The grammar is implemented TWICE -- src/kiro_crew/constants.py::strip_recommended_marker and website/src/app-sdk/protocol/recommendation.ts::splitRecommendation -- and nothing but these vectors stops the two drifting. Asserted by test/test_dispatch_sigil_parity.py and website/src/test/recommendation.test.ts. Both implementations return the ORIGINAL label when there is no marker, when the marker is the whole label, or when the cleaned label would open with a reserved dispatch sigil; so expected == label exactly when marker is false.
